public_output.executive_summary: In 2021, U.S. clothing purchasers aged 18+ had 77% online penetration before and 83% after the outbreak ends. In the U.S. 2021 chart, online penetration among grocery purchasers aged 18+ was 43% before the outbreak began and 56% after it ends. In the U.S. 2021 chart, online penetration among beauty/grooming purchasers aged 18+ was 57% before the outbreak began and 66% after it ends. During the COVID-19 outbreak, 27% of U.S. households signed up for a new paid shopping program membership. Of households that signed up for a new paid shopping program membership during the outbreak, 83% planned to keep at least one of those memberships over the next 12 months.
